_about: Real CheckoutPilot output for the demo stores, for the dashboard's Demo Mode and as the reference for the API contract (docs/api_contract.md). Scans: real scanner + AI rules + impact ranker (vision off in this run). Verification: real PayPal Sandbox payments made by sandbox_verifier on 8 Nov 2026. Fix: reference upgrade (legacy_store -> upgraded_store).

issues.title: PayPal JavaScript SDK v5 is outdated
issues.evidence: The store loads PayPal JavaScript SDK v5; PayPal's current version is v6.

impact.rationale: The store cannot use PayPal's current checkout features until it moves to SDK v6.
impact.assumption: PayPal's newer checkout features are built on JavaScript SDK v6. (PayPal developer docs: Upgrade from JavaScript SDK v5 to v6). Effect not measured for this store.
impact.assumption_source: PayPal developer docs: Upgrade from JavaScript SDK v5 to v6

issues.title: PayPal button missing on the cart page
issues.evidence: No PayPal element found on the cart page (desktop, mobile); shoppers only see PayPal at the final checkout step.

impact.rationale: Shoppers cannot choose one-click PayPal until the final checkout step.
impact.assumption: Saved PayPal accounts convert at over 95% on average when used as the default. (PayPal Q4 2025 earnings call). Effect not measured for this store.

issues.title: No PayPal button on the product page
issues.evidence: Shoppers must go to the cart or checkout before PayPal appears.

impact.rationale: Shoppers ready to buy must add to cart and continue before PayPal appears.
impact.assumption: Saved PayPal accounts convert at over 95% on average when used as the default. (PayPal Q4 2025 earnings call). Effect not measured for this store.

issues.title: PayPal button hidden below the fold on mobile
issues.evidence: On a mobile screen the shopper must scroll before the PayPal button appears.

impact.rationale: Mobile shoppers must scroll to find the PayPal button.
impact.assumption: A payment option that is not visible without scrolling is likely to be used less. (General usability heuristic (no published PayPal figure)). Effect not measured for this store.
impact.assumption_source: General usability heuristic (no published PayPal figure)

fix.summary: Upgrade PayPal JavaScript SDK v5 to v6, add PayPal express checkout to the cart page, and move the order summary and PayPal button above the form on mobile.

explanation.what_changed: Replaced the v5 script (paypal.com/sdk/js) and paypal.Buttons() with the v6 web SDK: paypal.createInstance() with a server-issued client token, findEligibleMethods(), createPayPalOneTimePaymentSession() and a <paypal-button>.
Added #paypal-button-container with a <paypal-button> under the cart total, using the same v6 payment session.
Order summary and PayPal button now come before the shipping form on small screens; desktop layout unchanged.

+@app.get("/api/paypal/client-token")
+def client_token() -> dict:
+    """Short-lived, browser-safe token the v6 SDK needs. The secret never leaves the server."""
+    client = _paypal_client()
+    try:
+        token = client.get_client_token()
